note: Three consecutive runs of make bench-parallel on the source of this commit.

runs.protocol: Each I/O mode and cache setting applies to every handle. 100000 documents of four fields on the native file backend, written in batches of 5000. One thread: scanBatches on a handle with scanWorkers 0. Default pool: scanBatches on a default backend, whose built-in pool of up to 4 workers scans and sends every row back to the calling thread. N workers: a warm pool of worker threads with a handle each; a round pins a snapshot, splits it into N ranges, sends each worker the head and one range, and ends when every worker has scanned its range and closed its pin. One untimed warmup that checks every case returns the same count and checksum, then 7 rounds alternating the order of the cases, each after a full garbage collection on the main thread.
